classification: developer-only observation crosswalk; never an engine target or prescribed choice
populationScope: Every initialized resident, including nonworkers and days without discretionary activation. Exact fixed-roster dated age exposure; no survey weights or civilian/noninstitutional eligibility inferred.
crosswalkStatus: paid-job-primary-time is a modeled subset; work-related commute/search/other activities are not supplied, so the reference is contextual, never an equality pass
gaps: No ATUS survey weighting/design, matched national age/employment sample, civilian/noninstitutional classification or territorial equivalence.
No complete mutually exclusive diary, commuting, job search, travel-purpose classification or employer/occupation-specific schedule evidence.
Overnight attendance units are dated portions, not completed whole shifts.
Committed on-call/24-hour duty is not automatically ATUS primary paid-work time; sleep/reserve conflicts can produce prototype absence.
No birth/death/migration producer; fixed-roster exposure is rejected if its initialized resident identities or current alive/residency facts change.
ATUS Table 3 age means are not individual schedules, coefficient bounds or within-person spreads.
Only currently captured cumulative category time is normalized. A historical subwindow requires dated numerator counters.
